h: मुझे अपनी भाषा से प्यार है

e: The fruit of hard work is sweet
sa: The fruit of hard work is sweet

h: बूँद बूँद से सागर बनता है
e: Drop by drop makes an ocean
sa: Drop by drop makes an ocean

e: Where there is a will there is a way
sa: Where there is a will there is a way

e: To fall and rise again is life
sa: To fall and rise again is life

e: Language is the soul of culture
sa: Language is the soul of culture

h: पहाड़ों के बीच एक छोटा सा गाँव था
e: There was a small village among the mountains
sa: There was a small village among the mountains

h: उस गाँव में एक बुज़ुर्ग महिला रहती थी
e: An elderly woman lived in that village
sa: An elderly woman lived in that village

h: वह अपनी पुरानी भाषा बोलती थी

e: But now there was no one to listen
sa: But now there was no one to listen

e: The children had moved to the city
sa: The children had moved to the city

h: उसकी भाषा धीरे धीरे खो रही थी

sa: Her language was slowly being lost

h: एक दिन एक छोटा रोबोट गाँव आया
e: One day a small robot came to the village

h: रोबोट ने कहा मुझे एक कहानी सुनाइए

e: The woman smiled and began to speak
sa: The woman smiled and began to speak

e: Now her stories will live forever
sa: Now her stories will live forever

h: भाषा बच गई और गाँव खुश हुआ
e: The language was saved and the village rejoiced
sa: The language was saved and the village rejoiced

h: महाराष्ट्र के जंगलों में वारली लोग रहते हैं
e: The Warli people live in the forests of Maharashtra
sa: The Warli people live in the forests of Maharashtra

sa: They paint pictures on the walls of mud houses

e: Triangles and circles are made with white color
sa: Triangles and circles are made with white color

h: हर चित्र एक कहानी कहता है

e: A young girl asked her grandmother
sa: A young girl asked her grandmother

h: दादी ने कहा ये हमारे पूर्वजों की आवाज़ हैं
e: Grandmother said these are the voices of our ancestors
sa: Grandmother said these are the voices of our ancestors

h: ये फसल और बारिश की कहानियाँ हैं

h: ये तारपा नृत्य की खुशी दिखाते हैं

h: उसने अपने चित्रों में नई कहानियाँ जोड़ीं

sa: She added new stories to her paintings

h: परंपरा एक पीढ़ी से दूसरी पीढ़ी तक चली

sa: The tradition passed from one generation to the next

e: The children played by the riverbank
sa: The children played by the riverbank

e: One year it did not rain
sa: One year it did not rain

sa: He said we must work together

e: The next year it rained a lot
sa: The next year it rained a lot

e: The river began to flow again
sa: The river began to flow again

sa: The robot was shaped like a brass lantern

e: Its job was to save languages
sa: Its job was to save languages

e: The robot traveled from village to village
sa: The robot traveled from village to village

h: वह बुज़ुर्गों के पास जाकर रुकता था

sa: It would stop near the elders

h: वह कहता था नमस्ते मैं सुन रहा हूँ

sa: It would say hello I am listening

h: लोग उसे अपनी कहानियाँ सुनाते थे

e: When someone got tired it would say

h: धीरे धीरे उसने सैकड़ों आवाज़ें इकट्ठी कीं

sa: Slowly it collected hundreds of voices

h: बच्चों ने उन आवाज़ों से अपनी भाषा सीखी
e: The children learned their language from those voices
sa: The children learned their language from those voices

h: इस तरह भाषा सेतु ने अतीत और भविष्य को जोड़ा
